knowledge_graph.title: Maui High School
knowledge_graph.description: Maui High School is a public high school founded in 1913 in Hamakuapoko, a sugarcane plantation town on the island of Maui in Hawaii. In 1972, the school moved to its new location in Kahului, Hawaii.

text_blocks.snippet: You can visit the Maui High School Official Website to learn more about its programs, academics, and schedules.
Maui has several public and private high schools serving different communities across the island:

list.snippet: Maui High School: Located in Kahului, serving central Maui with a student population of about 1,550 and career-themed academies.
Baldwin High School: Located in Wailuku, offering strong academic and athletic programs.
King Kekaulike High School: Located in Pukalani, serving upcountry Maui.
Lahainaluna High School: Located in Lahaina, famous as the oldest public high school west of the Rockies.
Kulanihakoʻi High School: Located in Kihei, serving South Maui students.
Hana High and Elementary School: Located in East Maui, serving remote communities.
Kihei Charter School: Publicly funded charter school in Kihei.
Kamehameha Schools Maui: Private K-12 campus in Pukalani/Makawao focusing on Hawaiian culture and rigorous academics.
Seabury Hall: Private college-preparatory school in Makawao.
